generate_instructions_for_scenes: run the SemiAutomated class to generate navigation instructions for Habitat simulator scenes using an LLM
initialize_habitat_simulator: create a Habitat simulator instance with camera sensors and physics enabled for a given scene
obtain_scene_info: build a scene info dictionary containing objects, furniture, receptacles, and object affordances from the simulator
generate_instructions_on_scene: generate templated navigation instructions for a scene by formatting prompts and calling the LLM
validate_scene: review the scene to print all regions, furniture, articulated objects, and the scene lexicon
